verdict.rationale: Folk documents people and companies as record types, with create/update/delete for people and custom fields on both. Gmail conversation sync and call/meeting logging suggest activity capture. However, no evidence shows that person and company records are linked to each other, or that each record has a full activity timeline. missing for 10: documented person-to-company record linking, a per-record activity timeline view, company record CRUD documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each
